target: DSH Web UI (headless Chromium over CDP)
dataModel: v3 (23-project workbranch ledger shape, exercised via the local v3 fixture)

v3Migration.parser: projects/*.yaml re-parsed as identity + gate0 + plan + progress[] + outcome
v3Migration.fourDimensions: read from outcome (achievement / our_proof / customer_recognition / business.milestone), each card tagged 自动推导 vs 人工填
v3Migration.progressStream: NEW — the core: every progress entry rendered as a timeline node with goal, items, actual, completion, evidence chips, customer sync/recognition, gate3_1/gate3_2 and next step
v3Migration.gapRules: 8 -> 12 (R1..R12), each pinned by its own unit test
v3Migration.stats: POC总数 / G0通过 / 进行中 / 金额合计 (sum of amount_wan)
v3Migration.table: 项目 | 体系/公司 | 阶段 | 金额 | 最新进展 | 缺口 | 操作
v3Migration.deferred: 导出表单 hidden (v1 field model kept in src/form.v1-deferred.ts) pending the P1 v3 rewrite

acceptance.poc006: 1500万 / G0未评审 / 缺2项 / 0进展

notes: Rewritten for the v3 ledger model. Verified against the REAL v3 data (all 23 files from the workbranch ledger copy) before any UI work: 23 projects, 6050万 total, 1 G0 passed, 0 G0 complete, R1 firing on all 23, R2 on 7 — exactly the acceptance numbers in the update note. The UI was then driven in headless Chromium with the v3 fixture: 43/43 assertions passed, including the new progress-stream section, the seven v3 table columns, the amount column and a check that no raw template placeholder leaks into the DOM. Two real defects were found and fixed during verification: (1) gap TITLES were rendered with t() instead of format(), so parameterised titles showed literal {amountWan}; (2) the identity line still used the v1 {tier} key, which no longer exists in v3. The four-dimension invariant is preserved but moved to the detail page: the v3 overview table has the spec's seven columns, and four separate dimension cards render on the detail page.
